title: ChemInform Abstract: Intermediacy of Paramagnetic Metal‐Hydrocarbyl Species in Organometallic Reactions. Detection and Characterization of a Novel Paramagnetic Iron(II)‐Benzyl Compound in the Coupling of Benzyl Halides.
abstract: AbstractDetection and characterization by NMR spectroscopy of the novel paramagnetic Fe(II)‐benzyl compound (IV) is reported which is the key intermediate in the coupling of benzyl halides (II) by complex (I) giving dibenzyl (VI).
